parseCsdl.title: parseCsdl
parseCsdl.description:
Parses XML or JSON CSDL without I/O. For ambiguous input, pass format
explicitly. JSON text must have an object root.

properties.name: input
properties.type: string | number | boolean | CsdlJsonInput[] | { [key: string]: CsdlJsonInput; } | null

properties.name: input
properties.type: string | number | boolean | CsdlJsonInput[] | { [key: string]: CsdlJsonInput; } | null

isCsdlDocument.title: isCsdlDocument
isCsdlDocument.description:
Checks the complete versioned, JSON-serializable CSDL document boundary.
This is intentionally vocabulary-neutral and performs no semantic validation.

resolveCsdlNullable.title: resolveCsdlNullable
resolveCsdlNullable.description:
Resolves the Nullable facet for nullable-capable CSDL elements.

The two encodings deliberately have different defaults: XML defaults omitted
Nullable to true, while JSON CSDL defaults it to false. The source field lets
semantic compilers distinguish an explicit choice from an encoding default.

canonicalizeCsdlDocument.title: canonicalizeCsdlDocument
canonicalizeCsdlDocument.description:
Produces the semantic input to the versioned hash. It excludes source
locations, source identity, raw input, comments, processing instructions,
insignificant XML whitespace, and JSON object-property ordering.

serializeCsdlDocument.title: serializeCsdlDocument
serializeCsdlDocument.description:
Serializes the plain-data public contract with stable object-key ordering.
Source-order arrays (XML children, JSON properties, expressions) remain ordered.

properties.name: contractVersion
properties.description: Version of this package's serialized document contract, not the OData version.

properties.name: idAlgorithm
properties.description: Version of the deterministic node identity algorithm.

properties.name: rawSource
properties.description: Present only when includeRawSource is explicitly enabled.

properties.name: properties
properties.description: Properties retain source order and duplicates.

properties.name: rawValue
properties.description: Exact JSON token, preserving large integer, decimal, and escaped string lexemes.

properties.name: maxDepth
properties.description: Maximum XML element or JSON container nesting. Defaults to 256.

properties.name: namespaces
properties.description: Namespace bindings in scope for this element. The empty key is the default namespace.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Element order is significant and is never sorted by the parser.

fetchRealXsuaaToken.title: fetchRealXsuaaToken
fetchRealXsuaaToken.description:
Fetches a real JWT token from SAP BTP XSUAA using Password Grant.
Used for local testing with real user data.

properties.name: credentials
properties.type: { clientid: string; clientsecret: string; url: string; }

parseXsuaaPolicies.title: parseXsuaaPolicies
parseXsuaaPolicies.description:
Transforms raw XSUAA data into a structured policy-based user context.
Robustly handles real BTP attributes and local mock formats.

XsuaaPayload.title: XsuaaPayload
XsuaaPayload.description:
Raw payload structure expected from the SAP XSUAA JWT token.
Supports both real XSUAA attributes and synthetic mock structures.

properties.name: 'userCompanies'
properties.type: { [key: string]: unknown; company: string; source: string; }[] | undefined

PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule
PolicyRule.description: Authorization rule mapping actions to subjects with specific conditions.

UserContext.title: UserContext
UserContext.description: Application-specific user context derived from the authentication token.

properties.name: update
properties.type: (id: string, updates: Partial<ODataLog>, options?: OdxLogUpdateOptions) => OdxMaybePromise<ODataLog | undefined>

$odata.title: $odata
$odata.description:
Low-level OData utility.
Executes a single OData request using the provided client.

$odataPage.title: $odataPage
$odataPage.description:
Executes a collection read while preserving count and safe server-driven
paging metadata in an SSR-serializable page object.

$odataWithResponse.title: $odataWithResponse
$odataWithResponse.description:
Executes an entity read while retaining only the ETag transport metadata
needed for optimistic concurrency. The HTTP header is authoritative; body
annotations are compatibility fallbacks for OData V4 and V2 services.

properties.name: client
properties.type: { raw: <R>(path: string, options?: any) => Promise<{ _data?: R; headers: { get: (name: string) => string | null; }; }>; }

$odataMutationWithResponse.title: $odataMutationWithResponse
$odataMutationWithResponse.description:
Executes an entity mutation while preserving its next ETag. The entity
representation is optional because an update may validly return 204.

properties.name: client
properties.type: { raw: <R>(path: string, options?: any) => Promise<{ _data?: R; headers: { get: (name: string) => string | null; }; }>; }

$odataActionWithResponse.title: $odataActionWithResponse
$odataActionWithResponse.description:
Executes an OData action while preserving a service-advertised response
location in addition to the ordinary mutation metadata. The location is
transport information only; callers own any follow-up request or polling.

properties.name: client
properties.type: { raw: <R>(path: string, options?: any) => Promise<{ _data?: R; headers: { get: (name: string) => string | null; }; }>; }

$odataCreateWithResponse.title: $odataCreateWithResponse
$odataCreateWithResponse.description:
Executes an entity create while preserving response metadata needed to
address a bodyless `Prefer: return=minimal` result.

properties.name: client
properties.type: { raw: <R>(path: string, options?: any) => Promise<{ _data?: R; headers: { get: (name: string) => string | null; }; }>; }

flattenOData.title: flattenOData
flattenOData.description:
Recursive flattener for OData V2/V4 structures and removes metadata.
Preserves count information if present.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The data to flatten

properties.name: depth
properties.description: Current recursion depth

properties.name: maxDepth
properties.description: Maximum recursion depth (default 10)

mergeHeaders.title: mergeHeaders
mergeHeaders.description: Merges multiple header initializers into a plain record.

sanitizeBaseURL.title: sanitizeBaseURL
sanitizeBaseURL.description: Sanitizes a base URL by removing redundant slashes and ensuring no trailing slash.

stringifyQuery.title: stringifyQuery
stringifyQuery.description:
Stringifies an OData query object into a URL-compatible record.
Handles special OData parameters like $filter and $expand.
Arrays (e.g. for $select) are joined with commas.

serializeODataBatchChangeSets.title: serializeODataBatchChangeSets
serializeODataBatchChangeSets.description: Serializes independent changesets into one OData batch request.

parseODataBatchChangeSetsResponse.title: parseODataBatchChangeSetsResponse
parseODataBatchChangeSetsResponse.description: Parses every independent changeset result without collapsing partial failures.

properties.name: body
properties.description: JSON value, or raw bytes with an explicit Content-Type header.

prepareSapCsrfHeaders.title: prepareSapCsrfHeaders
prepareSapCsrfHeaders.description:
Prepares request headers for SAP OData V2 and V4 mutations. Safe methods
pass through without a preflight request.

fetchWithCsrf.title: fetchWithCsrf
fetchWithCsrf.description:
Performs a server/edge request with a request-scoped SAP CSRF token and its
matching backend session cookies. Browsers must use the ODX proxy because
they cannot read Set-Cookie or emit a Cookie request header.

SapCsrfPreparationOptions.title: SapCsrfPreparationOptions
SapCsrfPreparationOptions.description: Server/edge options for a request-scoped SAP CSRF token preflight.

SapCsrfTokenError.title: SapCsrfTokenError
SapCsrfTokenError.description: Raised when an explicitly protected SAP mutation cannot obtain a token.

validateODataIdentifier.title: validateODataIdentifier
validateODataIdentifier.description: Validates and returns one OData identifier without path delimiters.

validateODataQualifiedName.title: validateODataQualifiedName
validateODataQualifiedName.description: Validates and returns a namespace-qualified OData name.

formatODataFunctionParameter.title: formatODataFunctionParameter
formatODataFunctionParameter.description: Serializes one typed primitive for OData V4 function inline-parameter syntax.

formatODataFunctionCall.title: formatODataFunctionCall
formatODataFunctionCall.description: Creates a validated qualified function call segment with inline parameters.

formatODataKey.title: formatODataKey
formatODataKey.description: Serializes a primitive or composite OData entity key for a resource path.

formatODataNavigationPath.title: formatODataNavigationPath
formatODataNavigationPath.description: Validates and joins one or more navigation-property segments.

joinODataPath.title: joinODataPath
joinODataPath.description: Joins already-addressable OData path fragments without altering URL schemes.

createODataEntityPath.title: createODataEntityPath
createODataEntityPath.description: Creates an exact entity resource path from a set name and key.

createODataMediaPath.title: createODataMediaPath
createODataMediaPath.description: Creates a validated entity or named-stream `$value` resource path.

createODataEntityReference.title: createODataEntityReference
createODataEntityReference.description: Creates a safe service-relative entity reference for an OData `$ref` body.

createODataNavigationSourcePath.title: createODataNavigationSourcePath
createODataNavigationSourcePath.description: Creates the exact keyed source path for a navigation operation.

createODataNavigationRootReference.title: createODataNavigationRootReference
createODataNavigationRootReference.description:
Creates the exact `$root` reference for a collection-valued navigation.

Aggregation transformations can use this service-root-relative identity
without asking higher layers to serialize entity keys or containment paths.

toODataCollectionPage.title: toODataCollectionPage
toODataCollectionPage.description:
Flattens an OData collection into an explicit page object. The explicit
`totalCount` field is serializable across Nuxt SSR payload boundaries,
unlike custom properties attached directly to arrays.

createODataContinuationPath.title: createODataContinuationPath
createODataContinuationPath.description: Anchors an opaque continuation to the caller-owned collection path.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The type of rule to apply (e.g., 'allowOnlyMethods', 'requireScope').

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value for the rule (e.g., ['GET', 'POST'], 'Admin', '/$metadata').

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Optional custom error message when the rule fails.

properties.name: url
properties.description:
Backend URL or local metadata path. May be omitted when `destination`
owns runtime target resolution or when the host injects the URL through
environment configuration.

properties.name: csrf
properties.description:
SAP CSRF policy for proxied mutations. Generic OData services default to
`none`; set `mode: 'sap'` to enable request-scoped token preparation.

properties.name: destination
properties.description: SAP BTP Destination name resolved by the server-side proxy.

properties.name: auth
properties.type: { username?: string; password?: string; bearerToken?: string; mockUserCompanies?: Array<{ company: string; source: string; }>; } | undefined

ODataAsyncData.title: ODataAsyncData
ODataAsyncData.description:
Minimal interface mimicking Nuxt's AsyncData for type inference.
The intersection with the raw type T helps the Vue template compiler
and IDE to see the unwrapped types without a direct Vue dependency.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Reactive data payload.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: Boolean state indicating if the request is in-flight.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Error object if the request failed.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status of the request: idle, pending, success, or error.

properties.name: refresh
properties.description: Function to manually refresh the data.

properties.name: execute
properties.description: Function to execute the request.

properties.name: clear
properties.description: Function to clear the data and error states.

ODataContinuation.title: ODataContinuation
ODataContinuation.description: Opaque query component for one server-driven collection continuation.

ODataCollectionPage.title: ODataCollectionPage
ODataCollectionPage.description:
Serializable collection result for list UIs that need the server-side count.
Unlike an extra property attached to an array, this shape survives Nuxt SSR
payload serialization.

properties.name: continuation
properties.description: Safe server-driven continuation without a backend origin or path.

ODataEntityResponse.title: ODataEntityResponse
ODataEntityResponse.description:
An entity read together with its optimistic-concurrency validator.
Arbitrary transport headers and OData metadata intentionally remain hidden.

ODataMutationResponse.title: ODataMutationResponse
ODataMutationResponse.description:
An entity mutation response with an optional representation. OData services
may legitimately answer PATCH with `204 No Content` while still returning
the next ETag header.

properties.name: sapMessage
properties.description: Legacy SAP Gateway success or warning message JSON.

ODataCreateResponse.title: ODataCreateResponse
ODataCreateResponse.description:
Created entity response with the optional identity advertised by the
service. A representation is optional when `Prefer: return=minimal` is used.

properties.name: entityId
properties.description: OData `OData-EntityId` response header, when supplied by the service.

properties.name: location
properties.description: HTTP `Location` response header, when supplied by the service.

ODataActionResponse.title: ODataActionResponse
ODataActionResponse.description: OData action result with optional response metadata and SAP feedback.

properties.name: location
properties.description: HTTP `Location` response header, when supplied by the service.

ODataMediaResponse.title: ODataMediaResponse
ODataMediaResponse.description: Binary OData entity or named-stream payload with safe response metadata.

ODataMediaRequestOptions.title: ODataMediaRequestOptions
ODataMediaRequestOptions.description: Options for an imperative OData media read.

properties.name: streamProperty
properties.description: Named `Edm.Stream` property; omit for a media entity's default stream.

ODataMediaUpdateOptions.title: ODataMediaUpdateOptions
ODataMediaUpdateOptions.description: Options for an imperative OData media replacement.

properties.name: contentType
properties.description: Exact request media type, for example `application/pdf`.

ODataMediaCreateOptions.title: ODataMediaCreateOptions
ODataMediaCreateOptions.description: Options for creating a media entity from its initial default stream.

properties.name: contentType
properties.description: Exact request media type, for example `application/pdf`.

properties.name: slug
properties.description: Optional OData `Slug` hint, commonly used as the original file name.

ODataMediaMutationResponse.title: ODataMediaMutationResponse
ODataMediaMutationResponse.description: Result metadata from a media replacement that may return no body.

properties.name: sapMessage
properties.description: Legacy SAP Gateway success or warning message JSON.

ODataMediaCreateResponse.title: ODataMediaCreateResponse
ODataMediaCreateResponse.description: Created media entity representation and optimistic-concurrency validator.

properties.name: entityId
properties.description: OData `OData-EntityId` response header, when supplied by the service.

properties.name: location
properties.description: HTTP `Location` response header, when supplied by the service.

ODataContainedEntitySegment.title: ODataContainedEntitySegment
ODataContainedEntitySegment.description: One keyed containment hop below an entity-set root.

ODataContainedEntitySource.title: ODataContainedEntitySource
ODataContainedEntitySource.description:
Structured source for navigation operations below a contained entity.
Keeping keys separate from navigation names prevents callers from building
executable OData resource paths with string concatenation.

ODataRequestOptions.title: ODataRequestOptions
ODataRequestOptions.description:
Portable options shared by imperative OData reads and mutations.

Framework adapters may accept additional transport-specific properties, but
portable consumers can rely on cancellation and exact request headers without
importing Nuxt, ofetch, or Node.js types.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Primitive EDM type used to serialize the URL literal safely.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Entity key for an entity- or navigation-bound function.

properties.name: navigationPath
properties.description: Optional navigation binding below the keyed entity.

properties.name: parameters
properties.description: Typed non-binding parameters serialized with OData inline syntax.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Root entity key or exact contained entity for an entity- or navigation-bound action.

properties.name: navigationPath
properties.description: Optional navigation binding below the keyed entity.

properties.name: parameters
properties.description: OData action parameters serialized as the POST body.

ODataQuery.title: ODataQuery
ODataQuery.description:
Structured OData query options.
T: The model type of the entity being queried.

properties.name: $select
properties.description: Select specific properties to return.

properties.name: $orderby
properties.description: Sort order (e.g. 'Price desc').

properties.name: $top
properties.description: Number of results to return.

properties.name: $skip
properties.description: Number of results to skip (offset).

properties.name: $filter
properties.description: Filter expression to restrict the results.

properties.name: $expand
properties.description: Expand navigation properties.

properties.name: $count
properties.description: Include the count of matching entities in OData V4 responses.

properties.name: $inlinecount
properties.description: Include the count of matching entities in OData V2 responses.

properties.name: $search
properties.description: Search expression (OData V4).

properties.name: $apply
properties.description: Aggregation pipeline (OData V4 Data Aggregation extension).

ODataEntitySet.title: ODataEntitySet
ODataEntitySet.description:
Interface for a specific OData Entity Set.
T: The model type of the entity.

properties.name: supportsContainedNavigationSources
properties.description:
Explicit runtime capability marker for structured contained-navigation
sources. Consumers must not infer this support from method names because
older ODX releases accepted only an entity key in the same position.

properties.name: supportsNavigationRootReferences
properties.description: Indicates that this client can produce validated `$root` navigation references.

properties.name: createNavigationRootReference
properties.type: ((source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[]) => string) | undefined
properties.description:
Produces a query-expression reference for the exact related collection.
This performs no request and never includes the service base URL.

properties.name: list
properties.description: Fetches a list of entities.

properties.name: fetchList
properties.description:
Performs an imperative list read without requiring a Nuxt composable
setup context.

properties.name: fetchNavigationList
properties.type: (source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T[]>
properties.description:
Performs an imperative collection read relative to an existing entity.
The navigation path accepts either a single slash-delimited path or
validated path segments.

properties.name: fetchOne
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T>
properties.description:
Performs an imperative single-entity read without requiring a Nuxt
composable setup context.

properties.name: get
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: any) => ODataAsyncDataPromise<T>
properties.description:
Fetches a single entity by key.
Key can be a single value or an object for composite keys.

properties.name: create
properties.description: Creates a new entity.

properties.name: createNavigation
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], body: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description:
Creates a new entity through a collection-valued navigation property of
an existing parent entity.

properties.name: updateNavigation
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], update: ODataNavigationUpdate, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description:
Updates an entity addressed through a navigation property of an existing
parent entity. Omit `targetKey` for a single-valued navigation and provide
it for an entity in a collection-valued navigation.

properties.name: removeNavigation
properties.type: (source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<unknown>
properties.description:
Deletes an entity addressed through a contained collection-valued
navigation while preserving the exact parent and related-entity identity.
This is an entity DELETE, not a non-contained relationship `$ref` unlink.

properties.name: update
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, body: Partial<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T>
properties.description: Updates an existing entity.

properties.name: remove
properties.description: Deletes an entity.

properties.name: invoke
properties.type: <TResult = unknown, TParameters = Record<string, unknown>>(action: string, invocation?: ODataActionInvocation<TParameters>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description: Invokes an unbound, collection-, entity-, or navigation-bound OData action.

properties.name: invokeFunction
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(functionName: string, invocation?: ODataFunctionInvocation, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description: Invokes an unbound, collection-, entity-, or navigation-bound OData function.

ODataNavigationReferenceEntitySet.title: ODataNavigationReferenceEntitySet
ODataNavigationReferenceEntitySet.description: Entity-set client that mutates non-contained relationships through OData `$ref`.

properties.name: linkNavigation
properties.type: (source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetEntitySet: string, targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<unknown>
properties.description: Adds an existing entity to a non-contained navigation through OData `$ref`.

properties.name: unlinkNavigation
properties.type: (source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<unknown>
properties.description: Removes an existing entity link without deleting the target entity.

ODataNavigationReferenceResponseEntitySe.title: ODataNavigationReferenceResponseEntitySet
ODataNavigationReferenceResponseEntitySe.description: Entity-set client that preserves response metadata from OData `$ref` writes.

properties.name: linkNavigationWithResponse
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetEntitySet: string, targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataMutationResponse<TResult>>
properties.description: Adds an existing relationship while preserving optional backend feedback.

properties.name: unlinkNavigationWithResponse
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataMutationResponse<TResult>>
properties.description: Removes an existing relationship while preserving optional backend feedback.

ODataPagedEntitySet.title: ODataPagedEntitySet
ODataPagedEntitySet.description:
Entity-set client with explicit, SSR-safe collection page reads. This
extends the original entity-set contract without making existing structural
implementations of `ODataEntitySet` add new required methods.

properties.name: listPage
properties.description:
Fetches entities and preserves an OData V2 `__count` or V4 `@odata.count`
in an SSR-safe object shape.

properties.name: fetchPage
properties.description: Imperative counterpart to `listPage`.

properties.name: listNavigation
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], query?: ODataQuery<TResult>, options?: any) => ODataAsyncDataPromise<TResult[]>
properties.description:
Reads a related collection through Nuxt AsyncData. The caller supplies the
related result model because a navigation path can target another entity
type than the root entity set.

ODataContinuationEntitySet.title: ODataContinuationEntitySet
ODataContinuationEntitySet.description: Entity-set client with safe server-driven paging support.

properties.name: listNextPage
properties.description: Reads the next page through Nuxt AsyncData on the current entity set.

properties.name: fetchNextPage
properties.description: Imperatively reads the next page on the current entity set.

properties.name: listNavigationPage
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], query?: ODataQuery<TResult>, options?: any) => ODataAsyncDataPromise<ODataCollectionPage<TResult>>
properties.description: Reads a page from a related collection through Nuxt AsyncData.

properties.name: fetchNavigationPage
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], query?: ODataQuery<TResult>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataCollectionPage<TResult>>
properties.description: Imperative counterpart to `listNavigationPage`.

properties.name: listNavigationNextPage
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], continuation: ODataContinuation, options?: any) => ODataAsyncDataPromise<ODataCollectionPage<TResult>>
properties.description: Continues a related collection through Nuxt AsyncData.

properties.name: fetchNavigationNextPage
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], continuation: ODataContinuation, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataCollectionPage<TResult>>
properties.description: Imperatively continues a related collection on the same navigation path.

ODataVersionedEntitySet.title: ODataVersionedEntitySet
ODataVersionedEntitySet.description:
Entity-set client with explicit access to optimistic-concurrency metadata.
Kept separate so existing structural `ODataPagedEntitySet` implementations
remain source-compatible.

properties.name: fetchOneWithResponse
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataEntityResponse<T>>
properties.description:
Imperatively reads one entity and preserves its ETag for a subsequent
conditional mutation. Existing `fetchOne` remains body-only.

ODataNavigationEntityRead.title: ODataNavigationEntityRead
ODataNavigationEntityRead.description: Exact related-entity read below a root or contained entity.

properties.name: targetKey
properties.description: Key of one collection member; omit for a single-valued navigation.

ODataVersionedNavigationEntitySet.title: ODataVersionedNavigationEntitySet
ODataVersionedNavigationEntitySet.description: Entity-set client that preserves response metadata from related entities.

properties.name: fetchNavigationOneWithResponse
properties.description: Reads one related entity and preserves its ETag for a conditional mutation.

ODataConcurrencyEntitySet.title: ODataConcurrencyEntitySet
ODataConcurrencyEntitySet.description:
Entity-set client with an explicit optimistic-concurrency mutation path.
Kept separate so structural implementations of `ODataVersionedEntitySet`
remain source-compatible.

properties.name: updateWithResponse
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, body: Partial<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataMutationResponse<T>>
properties.description:
Conditionally updates one entity while preserving the response ETag.
Existing `update` remains body-only and source-compatible.

properties.name: updateNavigationWithResponse
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], update: ODataNavigationUpdate, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataMutationResponse<TResult>>
properties.description: Updates a related entity while preserving its optional next ETag.

ODataMergeEntitySet.title: ODataMergeEntitySet
ODataMergeEntitySet.description: Entity-set client with explicit SAP Gateway OData V2 MERGE updates.

properties.name: merge
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, body: Partial<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T>
properties.description: Performs an explicit SAP Gateway OData V2 MERGE update.

properties.name: mergeWithResponse
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, body: Partial<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataMutationResponse<T>>
properties.description: Performs MERGE and preserves its optional representation and next ETag.

ODataCreateEntitySet.title: ODataCreateEntitySet
ODataCreateEntitySet.description: Entity-set client with explicit create response metadata.

properties.name: createWithResponse
properties.description:
Creates an entity while preserving its optional representation, ETag, and
service-advertised identity. This supports `Prefer: return=minimal`.

properties.name: createNavigationWithResponse
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], body: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataCreateResponse<TResult>>
properties.description: Creates a related entity while preserving a possibly bodyless response.

ODataActionResponseEntitySet.title: ODataActionResponseEntitySet
ODataActionResponseEntitySet.description: Entity-set client that preserves response metadata from OData actions.

properties.name: invokeWithResponse
properties.type: <TResult = unknown, TParameters = Record<string, unknown>>(action: string, invocation?: ODataActionInvocation<TParameters>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataActionResponse<TResult>>
properties.description:
Invokes an OData action while preserving its optional representation,
response ETag, advertised location, and legacy SAP Gateway message header.

ODataDeleteResponseEntitySet.title: ODataDeleteResponseEntitySet
ODataDeleteResponseEntitySet.description: Entity-set client that preserves response metadata from OData deletes.

properties.name: removeWithResponse
properties.description: Deletes an entity while preserving optional response metadata.

properties.name: removeNavigationWithResponse
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<ODataDeleteResponse<TResult>>
properties.description: Deletes a related entity while preserving optional response metadata.

ODataMediaEntitySet.title: ODataMediaEntitySet
ODataMediaEntitySet.description: Entity-set client with imperative OData media-stream reads and replacements.

properties.name: createMedia
properties.description: Creates a media entity by posting its initial default stream.

properties.name: createNavigationMedia
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], body: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array, options: ODataMediaCreateOptions) => Promise<ODataMediaCreateResponse<TResult>>
properties.description:
Creates a contained media entity through a collection-valued navigation
by posting its initial default stream.

properties.name: fetchMedia
